context: A grandma weaves an old-world fairy tale for her granddaughter
purpose: Teach: 魔法/王国/惑星/儀式/後日/ふさわしい/予感/癒し

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: むかしむかし、遠い惑星の片隅に、小さな魔法王国があってね。
lines.en: Long ago, in the corner of a distant planet, there was a small magic kingdom.
lines.style: Warm storytelling cadence, drawing the child slowly into the world

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 惑星って、お星さまのこと？王国にはお姫さまもいたの？
lines.en: A planet, you mean like a star? Was there a princess in the kingdom too?
lines.style: Bright curious questions, leaning in with sparkling wide eyes

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ええ、心の優しい姫がいてね、王女にふさわしい娘だと皆が言っていたよ。
lines.en: Yes, there was a kind-hearted princess, and everyone said she was truly fitting for royalty.
lines.style: Gentle reverent tone, painting the princess with quiet pride

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ふさわしいって、すごく似合うってこと？なんだか、わくわくする予感がするよ！
lines.en: Does fitting mean it really suits her? Somehow, I have an exciting feeling about this!
lines.style: Excited childlike interjection, bouncing slightly with anticipation

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ある日ね、姫は森で古い儀式を見つけて、傷ついた森を癒し始めたの。
lines.en: One day, the princess discovered an ancient ritual in the forest and began healing the wounded woods.
lines.style: Soft mysterious tone, weaving magic into each careful word

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 魔法の力で癒したの？お姫さま、すごい！それで、それで？
lines.en: She healed it with magic power? The princess is amazing! And then, and then?
lines.style: Breathless eager pushing, tugging gently at grandma's sleeve

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 後日、その姫は星の女王となって、ずっと王国を守り続けたんだよ。
lines.en: Later on, that princess became queen of the stars and protected the kingdom forever.
lines.style: Tender concluding warmth, tucking the tale into a soft ending

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: わたしも、おっきくなったらお姫さまになりたいなあ。
lines.en: When I grow up, I want to become a princess too, you know.
lines.style: Dreamy sleepy wonder, voice trailing into a happy yawn
